mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, which precedes corporate earnings contraction and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as revenue expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates supply-side contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during a supply-driven recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) below 1250.0 thousand units signals housing sector contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1250.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A strong monthly payroll gain (PAYEMS) above 150,000 jobs signals robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 150,000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0), the tight labor market supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates expanding manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.
